reviews.x: This beard oil is as slick and great as thick cut maple bacon on a cold winter morning. Light aromatic notes of crisp fresh red grapes, but manly, like grapes 🍇 feed by a harem of Greek goddesses along the Mediterranean. The silkeenees of the oil, bathed the beard as if a dozen Spartan princesses poured olive oil squeezed by the hands of Ares, the God of War. Yeah I like it!!

Love this stuff. Bought it for my boyfriend since beard oil is hard to find and when I would find it it was expensive! The balm is making his beard softer and, bonus points, it smells really good 😍. Also he loves the comb it came with. Highly recommend it.

Stumbled across Premium Nature Beard Grooming Kit after my boyfriend complained that he couldn't find any beard balm/oil for a decent price and of course I replied with "Amazon will never fail me!" The reviews promised a great smell and I can tell you what, this stuff smells wonderful!! And it's a GREAT deal! He has only used it for two days but so far my boyfriend has said his face doesn't itch from dry skin at all and he loves the lasting smell, so.... so far, so good! Will update late

The comb is solid. There is a massive difference in combing a beard with wood vs. plastic. Both the balm and the oil have their own specific scents but what's cool is that if you combine them (I use the oil first out of the shower, dry with hair dryer on low and cool, then add the balm as a top coat for shape management) they make a great smell together. Will be buying this again when the oil/balm runs out and then I'll have another wooden comb for the car.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as pleasant, woodsy, and not overpowering.
Many customers say the products make their beards softer, more moisturized, and easier to manage.
The included comb is commonly praised as sturdy and effective, especially compared to plastic combs.
Several reviewers highlight the kit as a good value for the price.
A few negative reviews mention a wrong item being sent, a cheap feel with an aftershave-like smell, and repeated price increases.
